notes.title: 1st Update Now Live! 10 New Callouts, Private Online Games, Mac Version Launched, Spanish Localisation
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/99ede88486064a6d6caa37eb68e800c97508ff12.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

Flashing Lights launched a little under 24 hours ago and we wanted to thank everyone for supporting the development of the game and providing us with feedback. We've had a fantastic response from the community, and we cannot thank you all enough.

We have just launched a brand new content update, less than 24 hours since launch! The update includes ten new callouts across the Fire and EMS departments. Additionally players will be able to set passwords when creating an online game, meaning that you can now create private games and share the password with your friends.

And finally we have added Spanish translation into the game, as well as provided a few bug fixes.

[b]We have also just launched the Mac version of Flashing Lights.[/b]

A full change log can be found below:

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list][*]3 new vehicle fire callouts for the fire department [Call ID 15; 16; 17]
[*]2 new rescue callouts for the fire department (single player only) [Call ID 18; 19]
[*]5 new callouts for the EMS department [Call ID 18; 19; 20; 21; 22]
[*]Password option for multiplayer games - meaning that you will be able to make private multiplayer games and give your friends the password to join the game.
[*]Spanish translation[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Traffic Stop (Left Ctrl) will automatically enable emergency lights if they are off.
[*]Traffic stopped vehicles will now correctly despawn when you move out of the area.
[*]Vehicles with no driver, no longer move on their own.
[*]Parked vehicles - Illegally parked vehicles will change on each session load.
[*]NPCs who stopped after getting out of a player's way will now continue to move again once the player passes.
[*]Hose correctly despawns.
[*]Interacting with a stretcher close to a wall will no longer make the player fall through the floor.
[*]Player correctly resets when underwater while holding an item or interacting with NPCs.
[*]Hospital will now accept all patients instead of denying every second patient.[/list]

We're already fixing further issues and responding to some suggestions from the community for the next update. Once again, we thank you for the great amount of support, and hope that you enjoy watching the game evolve throughout development.

As a reminder, we have announced just a taste of the things to come throughout Early Access in the image below, and today's update sees us start to deliver on the content mentioned below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/a55138b4ec31e81e37c898c97b6223ddbfb25648.jpg[/img]

And with that, we've kept you long enough! Why not jump into the game while it's at 10% off for the launch week if you're yet to play? Or why not jump back into the game and play the new missions if you are already an owner of Flashing Lights

Thanks,
The Flashing Lights Team

notes.title: Flashing Lights Out Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/fb205d2210b59f224aa2d391c229009943f385e1.jpg[/img]

Hello officers, medics and firefighters! 

Flashing Lights has just launched in Early Access. Play as a police officer, medic or firefighter in single player, or online with up to five other people. We hope that you join us, have fun with the game and offer some feedback!

As this is an Early Access launch, there is much more to come. We have put together a list of upcoming content that will be worked on during the Early Access period. This is by no means a complete Early Access roadmap, but just a taste of what we are working on. The roadmap will be updated throughout Early Access.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/a55138b4ec31e81e37c898c97b6223ddbfb25648.jpg[/img]

We are already working on the first update which contains the following additions and enhancements.

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list][*]3 new vehicle accident fire callouts for the fire department [Call ID 15; 16; 17]
[*]2 new rescue callouts for the fire department (single player only) [Call ID 18; 19]
[*]5 new callouts for the EMS department [Call ID 18; 19; 20; 21; 22]
[*]Password option for multiplayer games - meaning that you will be able to make private multiplayer games and give your friends the password to join the game.
[*]Spanish translation[/list]

We want to thank everyone who has shown their support for the game so far and a massive thank you to those who joined us during the Alpha testing period. 

This is just the beginning and we hope that many of you will follow the development, sharing your feedback and suggestions.

Happy launch day,
The Flashing Lights Team

notes.title: Flashing Lights - Dev Diary #3 | Reputation System
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/5930f26f1e198516b4a1062efaee8a37d6f5a368.gif[/img]

Hello everyone,

I'm very excited to offer you all another update on Flashing Lights today, via our 3rd developer diary video! This time around, we're taking a look at the newly implemented reputation system, which will track your in-game actions and give you feedback on your performance in real time.

Take a look at the brand new video below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hpjoc25IxBQ

Need to catch up on the dev diary series? We've put together a handy little playlist on YouTube with all three dev diaries to date:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GtuisFnL83s&list=PL-PaLbhSNk6C_v86wuHnISoDRvcuC-uSc

[h1]Flashing Badge Giveaway[/h1]

We also are running an exciting giveaway where you could win a flashing Flashing Lights badge! Click on either of the images below, depending on your choice of social media platform, to be taken to the post!

[h1]Twitter[/h1]

[url=https://twitter.com/FLSimulatorGame/status/998966495181975553] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/a902c6188874d0bbc11fffeaeb0ea4eb7ce82d28.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Facebook[/h1]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/flashinglightsgame/videos/1712162408839318/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/98748c68802676d9491de9cfc0e41635080bfd6b.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for joining us on this journey, and we cannot wait to launch Flashing Lights in Early Access on 7th June! If you are yet to do so, make sure to add the game to your Steam wishlist to keep up to date!

Thanks,
The Flashing Lights Team

notes.title: Flashing Lights Release Date Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/9f97f7200eb3cdf73843fcd8c98a2f9aee029d88.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

We have some important news to share today. Flashing Lights will now launch on 7th June 2018 in Early Access.

While originally set for release on 18th May 2018, Flashing Lights has been delayed in order to secure a stronger Early Access launch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/b9e48817d6967340f616156cfe433ce0cd9f307b.png[/img]

The three-week delay allows us time to not only polish Flashing Lights further, but to add more missions and content for the Early Access launch. As a result of the short delay, Flashing Lights’ Early Access launch will now feature a reputation system which charts players’ in-game actions in real-time, such as completing missions or causing damage to the city.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/1aa7fec95fdb38f3f9242467376656c5566ad06f.png[/img]

We realise that delays, even small ones, are always disappointing, and we apologise for pushing back the release date. Rest assured, though, that the Early Access release will be much better for it.

If you haven't already, please do add the game to your Steam wishlist to stay up to date!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/92e031f772aaa17284e460383bf76c027109a674.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your support and understanding - we can't wait to open the floodgates and welcome you all to Flashing Lights on 7th June.

Thanks,
The Flashing Lights Team

notes.title: Closed Alpha Will Go Live Tomorow - BUGS!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've been working on the build of Flashing Lights today, but unfortunately due to some technical issues we have had to delay the closed alpha by one day. 

Part of the process for Early Access is asking players to help locate some bugs and report them to us. Below are just few of the issues that we've been addressing over the past couple of days:

- Players were able to enter the passenger seats of other players vehicles, but were unable to escape!
- Parking a vehicle in a position where another online players vehicle will spawn would lead to a mesmerizing vehicular balancing act!
- Richard Anderson was wanted by the police department for reckless driving, Every pedestrian spawned however had the name Richard Anderson!
- While attending an accident, a driver was trapped inside the car. The Fire Department stood outside with jaws of Life Equipped, but unable to understand how to free this poor man from his vehicular prison.
- Fireman obtained the powers of levitation and something needed to be done before he could use this for evil.
-When a police officer leaves the vehicle, they jump in excitement (This has been reduced but not fixed 100%).
-After using the jaws of life to free a trapped driver, the vehicle will be upset and begin to generate its own gravitational pull, causing the player to be pulled back to the car.
- Once successfully stopping a reckless driver, there was a chance that the driver would then obtain the powers of teleportation and vanish. No idea while he was driving so fast, he could have just teleported...
- When right clicking, the camera would zoom into the foot of the player... Don't ask why.
- If a player is sitting in another players vehicle while they change roles, the vehicle will despawn and it will appear that they will be flying Wonder Woman's invisible plane.

Below are a few in screenshot form

[h1]The T Pose Policeman watches you while selecting a new job role. He needs more officers[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/f5c2564da490709d91c7f1682916fb47f035c588.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Ambulance blocks the spawn location for the fire truck. Fireman is unable to reach the doors[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/586ea81f2d6a12abd0929af2432cbf9e7c63cbe5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Police Officer sitting in the passenger side of Wonder Women's invisible jet[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/e17a243532c89be95ef354ad4726613a1dda1f66.jpg[/img]

[h1]The fire hose has unlimited reach and can be used to create works of art![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/37c2554d1729286c21a2494a6fa089adff617af7.jpg[/img]

[h1]When a fireman entered a fire truck, he would spawn a police officer in the drivers seat. The police officer would be sitting in a ridiculous position and the player will be able to control both the truck AND the on foot fireman at the same time... Just straight up odd![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/1522bd235563dd966a8e5081b33f43a56011c370.jpg[/img]

Of course, some bugs are hilarious, others are frustrating. Some of these were progress stopping which meant that players would be unable to continue playing. If you are accepted into the closed alpha, prepare for the good, the bad and the odd. Any reports would greatly help us in fixing issues and improving the game.

We'll be sending out an email tomorrow with steam codes. Some of the bugs above are fixed, others may still be present. But of course, it's important to share these details. We will be releasing in Early Access, which means that the game will not be complete and will most certainly contain a bunch of bugs too. This is the nature of the beast and any help from the community this early on is very useful!

I hope you can understand the small delay and we are looking forward to seeing some of you try out the game for the first time.

notes.title: Traffic Lights, Parking Tickets, Quick Update On Art
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We hope that everyone has had an excellent start to 2018. We've come back from the holidays fully charged and eager to hop on to develop the game. Over the past few weeks we've been working on the AI traffic and the parking ticket system.

[h1] Traffic AI[/h1]
AI drivers were previously a menace to society, ignoring any designated rules of the road and causing a selection of disastrous vehicular collisions which not only caused some vehicles to probably be classified as write offs, but would also cause a pile up of stationary vehicles blocking traffic. 

Some work has however been done to improve the AI and they now stop and yield to incoming traffic at intersections. While this should of course be expected, we're still pleased with how the system is working right now.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/8e44e5faa9e10ca5a3d2ac6f85f5cb6492f361d5.gif[/img]

Additionally, we've also worked on Traffic light systems and have synchronized the lights so that they work with online multiplayer. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/b136dbbb44b867c94f36bf27635727137eb91e8f.gif[/img]

[h1]Parking[/h1]
When loading the game, each session will see cars placed in various parking spots. This kind of adds to the world as there is always a row of cars on the road. But there will be times when a busy road may have fewer cars parked in that particular area and other times when a quiet cul de sac will see an increase in parked cars. Of course, this leads to the environment changing slightly and may even play a factor in accessibility to certain areas.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/533fbbdb486ceb19a177100188df04cf62602b4c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Parking Tickets[/h1]
The bane of the average driver, parking tickets. As an on the beat police officer you will be able to issue parking tickets to various vehicles based on whether they were in a no parking zone, parked in a handicapped area without displaying a proper disabled badge. You as the player will need to decide what reason you are issuing a parking ticket and then fill out the form

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/b94fc2d0b33edac3fbd9bd6518d5c704d716bb03.gif[/img]

Any tickets that you create will then be placed on the actual vehicle and can be seen and read by other players online.

[h1]Online Multiplayer Testing With PC and MAC[/h1]
Flashing Lights Early Access release will see both PC and MAC support. We've been doing some testing with both platforms communicating with each other online. Everything seems to be working pretty much right away! So regardless of your friends platform of choice, you'll be able to play with them. Below are just a few images of a Mac and PC player playing online together

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/12376153f77053e43224eb23de80fcc54fbd6bfa.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/d68601103f7b4ed52ca9f11291a1a7f56ad0644d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/69aa423f5d341b3f693dd939c78b794f905a1fe8.jpg[/img]

Note: We do not condone any fire department to blast a police officer in the face with a water directly from a fire hose, there's a high probability that they won't take too kindly to that...

[h1]Short Graphics And Art Update[/h1]
In other news we are at the stages of working with an art audio who will be creating 3D models for Flashing Lights. We are anticipating that we will also be working with other individual artists for game objects too. Nothing is quite yet set in stone, but we hope that working with these artists will definitely allow us to bring Flashing Lights up to scratch on a visual level

So there we have it! this week has been working on parts of the AI and elements of the police role. Next month we will be looking at introducing a few game mechanics to both the Fire and EMS so stay tuned for some more info on those services in due course!

Thanks to everyone who has shown support in Flashing Lights, we've seen a massive spike in the forums and even on the figures for the wishlist numbers on Steam. If you have come across the game and want to be kept up to date with news, do add the game to your wishlist. More news will be incoming soon!

But there will be times when a busy road may have fewer cars parked in that particular area and other times when a quiet cul de sac will see an increase in parked cars. Of course, this leads to the environment changing slightly and may even play a factor in accessibility to certain areas.

The bane of the average driver, parking tickets. As an on the beat police officer you will be able to issue parking tickets to various vehicles based on whether they were in a no parking zone, parked in a handicapped area without displaying a proper disabled badge. You as the player will need to decide what reason you are issuing a parking ticket and then fill out the form
Any tickets that you create will then be placed on the actual vehicle and can be seen and read by other players online.

Flashing Lights Early Access release will see both PC and MAC support. We've been doing some testing with both platforms communicating with each other online. Everything seems to be working pretty much right away! So regardless of your friends platform of choice, you'll be able to play with them. Below are just a few images of a Mac and PC player playing online together

In other news we are at the stages of working with an art audio who will be creating 3D models for Flashing Lights. We are anticipating that we will also be working with other individual artists for game objects too. Nothing is quite yet set in stone, but we hope that working with these artists will definitely allow us to bring Flashing Lights up to scratch on a visual level
Next month we will be looking at introducing a few game mechanics to both the Fire and EMS so stay tuned for some more info on those services in due course!

notes.title: First Person Driving View, In Car Computer, AI Drivers
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/beec893bbe3dd99571a5b9cf9b334ed88bdd5f56.gif[/img]

Hello everyone. 

We have quite a number of things to talk with you about in today in our last post of 2017. We believe 2018 will be a very exciting year! Flashing Lights will enter Early Access and by the end of the year we hope to have implemented many of the suggestions from the community.

But let's get this year out of the way first and tell you what we've been working on for the last couple of weeks.

[h1]First Person Driving View[/h1]
With a simple press of a button, you'll be able to switch back and forth between third person and first person driving view.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/8b5a1864fe97f13b0247d455105c78695514a346.gif[/img]

Of course, this is still very muck work in progress with the spedometer not working right now and some of the art is still placeholder while we begin our work in securing artists. But it already makes driving much more exciting, even when involved in some crashes!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/158d1c8a9c833d123206434208eebe4e626401a8.gif[/img]

The mirrors also work, as you can see from video evidence of the patrol car being rear ended by a civilian!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/3f63cefce6d65c01c6b106c34c3223f2619c1115.gif[/img]

[h1]The In Car Computer[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/9b9f4861d9fa15310d20fd234ec659e0faca532c.png[/img]

Some of you may have noticed the chunky PC screen inside the patrol car. We're actually very pleased with this system and hope that it makes a lot of sense to players who want to operate the PC while driving.

Simply when in the car you can press the Shift key and this will create a cursor in the bottom right corner of the screen. This means that you can operate the PC  by gently moving your viewpoint up or down while core focus is still on the road. It takes a bit of getting used to but it is very intuitive to use.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/a79d6b4b877342d8c326bfa47a8237e0eb7db94c.gif[/img]

[h1]AI Drivers[/h1]
And lastly as part of today's update we have also been working on AI drivers. They can use all of the roads for the new map.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/2d261ad636d6b8f3573d4613046a5cd32da9b699.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/ad30dc1bd0737cefc47a798f9bcdb5aa3b36416e.gif[/img]

They do right now have some lightning quick reflexes and are by no means complete. There is still quite a bit of work to do as some particularly nasty accidents can also occur at times.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/cd7855f8007b9636a276bdf14dc1faa15d8c5e08.jpg[/img]

So that's it for todays post, we hope that you join us into the new year when development will really start to ramp up. We'll have new artwork to share, new features and of course the games first release as a Early Access title.

We thank every one of you for the support and if you want to continue to support the game and be the first to find out any news, make sure to wish list the game on Steam.

From all of us, happy holidays and here is to a spectacular new year!
